**CIRS’ mission is to identify and apply scientific principles for the purpose of advancing
regulatory and HTA policies and processes in developing and facilitating access to pharmaceutical
products**

The Centre for Innovation in Regulatory Science (CIRS) is a neutral research organisation that
provides a forum for policy leaders from government regulators, HTA agencies, the pharmaceutical
industry and other stakeholders in healthcare, such as patient organisations and academia. CIRS
works collaboratively with stakeholders worldwide, runs research projects internationally and
conducts meetings globally to feed into and build on its research.

## DefeatDD is sunsetting in December 2025.

Since 2010, we’ve been working to raise awareness of the burden of diarrheal disease and increase
investment in solutions. As we prepare to sunset PATH’s DefeatDD Initiative at the end of December
2025, we celebrate the remarkable progress made over the past 15 years with our fellow advocates,
partners, governments, and collaborators.

Since 2000, child deaths from diarrhea have fallen by more than 70 percent, a number that makes us
*flush *with pride—and confident in the momentum ahead.

While this site will no longer be updated after December 31, 2025, we hope you will continue to
raise your voice. We invite you to stay engaged with the amazing organizations we’ve had an
opportunity to collaborate with over the years, including but not limited to:
* 1000 Days
* Aga Khan Foundation
* CHAI
* Child Health Task Force
* CIDRZ
* Clean the World
* ColaLife
* Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance
* Global Citizen
* Global Handwashing Partnership
* Global Task Force for Cholera Control
* Icddr,b
* International Vaccine Access Center
* JSI
* ONE Campaign
* The POOP Project
* PSI
* Save the Children
* USAID
* WaterAid
* World Vision
* Zinc Fortification Task Force

To every partner, advocate, and toilet enthusiast who has supported our work: Thank you. Your

investment in solutions. As we prepare to sunset PATH’s DefeatDD Initiative at the end of December

partners, governments, and collaborators.

*flush *with pride—and confident in the momentum ahead.

Who We Are

## A Global Alliance Born from a Single Conversation

GAZHP connects Zambian healthcare professionals living abroad with those at home — creating a
powerful bridge of expertise, mentorship, and resources to uplift Zambia's entire health system.

**Diaspora-Led, Locally Grounded** Our members span multiple countries but keep Zambia at the center
of every initiative.
**Healthcare Professionals Driving Solutions** Doctors, nurses, and allied health professionals —
not just donors — lead our programs.
**Focus on Sustainability** We build capacity so Zambia becomes self-sufficient, not dependent on
external aid.
**Founded in 2019** after Dr. David Kazhila was asked on a radio program what physicians could
contribute to Zambia. By December 2019, GAZHP was formally registered as a nonprofit.

[Read Our Full Story][18]
Core Programs

## Where We Focus Our Efforts

Our three flagship programs target the areas of greatest need in Zambia's health landscape,
combining diaspora expertise with local partnerships.

[Mental Health]
Program 01
Addiction & Mental Health

Promoting awareness and culturally relevant mental health services through local and diaspora
partnerships. Breaking the stigma and building accessible, compassionate care across Zambia.

[Cardiovascular Care]
Program 02
Cardiovascular Care

Strengthening heart care through clinical training, specialist mentorship, telemedicine
consultations, and partnerships with global cardiology experts.

[Family Medicine & Primary Care]
Program 03
Family Medicine & Primary Care

Building the backbone of Zambia's health system through training, research, and international
collaboration. Strong primary care for every community.

[View All Programs][19]
Our Approach

## Four Pillars of Impact

Everything we do flows through four core functions that ensure sustainable, accountable, and
ethically driven healthcare transformation.

### Collaborate

Connect diaspora professionals with local practitioners and communities, building bridges of
knowledge and care that span continents.

### Build Capacity

Strengthen clinical skills through training, mentorship, and continuous medical education —
empowering Zambia's own healthcare workforce.

### Innovate

Leverage technology, telemedicine, and research for improved healthcare delivery — bringing
cutting-edge solutions to underserved communities.

### Support Care Delivery

Mobilize resources and partnerships for frontline services, ensuring that life-saving care reaches
patients in the most remote areas.

## What Makes Us Different

homeland's health future.

### Diaspora-Led, Locally Grounded

Our members live abroad but our roots — and our focus — remain firmly in Zambia. We understand both
worlds.

professional accountability.

Every project is designed to build lasting capacity. We empower Zambia's own workforce rather than
creating reliance on external support.

### Accountable, Ethical, Collaborative

As a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, we operate with full transparency, ethical governance, and deep
community collaboration.

# Make healthcare universal

OpenSRP is software that helps frontline health workers manage patients and provide services to all.
Now with FHIR 🔥

[
Email info@opensrp.io for a demo
][14]

OpenSRP 2 is an open-source FHIR-native platform designed to support health systems delivering
services and collecting data offline in communities and facilities. The platform has been used in 14
country implementations (including 4 national systems) and has over 150 million patients registered
as of June 2023.

OpenSRP 2, a new version released in 2023, combines WHO health workflows with FHIR to transform how
healthcare is delivered and managed.

### New Global Immunization Product Suite

We recently released the an Electronic Immunization Registry (EIR) product suite, meant to
strengthen delivery of immunization services with OpenSRP 2.

[Read More][15]

### OpenSRP at a Glance

# Make healthcare universal

OpenSRP is software that helps frontline health workers manage patients and provide services to all.
Now with FHIR 🔥

[
Email info@opensrp.io for a demo
][14]

OpenSRP 2 is an open-source FHIR-native platform designed to support health systems delivering
services and collecting data offline in communities and facilities. The platform has been used in 14
country implementations (including 4 national systems) and has over 150 million patients registered
as of June 2023.

OpenSRP 2, a new version released in 2023, combines WHO health workflows with FHIR to transform how
healthcare is delivered and managed.

### New Global Immunization Product Suite

We recently released the an Electronic Immunization Registry (EIR) product suite, meant to
strengthen delivery of immunization services with OpenSRP 2.

# Mastering Global Regulatory Affairs in the Pharmaceutical Industry

## 1. Understanding the Role of Pharma Regulatory Affairs

Pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs is a multidisciplinary function within the pharmaceutical and
biotechnology industries. It plays a critical role in ensuring that all products—drugs, biologics,
and medical devices—comply with the regulations and standards required by regulatory agencies across
various countries. The regulatory affairs department acts as the interface between pharmaceutical
companies and regulatory bodies such as the FDA (United States), EMA (European Union), CDSCO
(India), PMDA (Japan), and TGA (Australia). These agencies are responsible for reviewing and
approving drug applications, overseeing safety reporting, and enforcing post-approval compliance.

At its core, regulatory affairs involves the preparation, compilation, and submission of a wide
range of regulatory documents. These documents include dossiers (CTD/eCTD), product labels, periodic
safety reports, clinical trial applications, and responses to regulatory queries. In addition, the
regulatory team ensures that the company’s products are registered correctly in each market,
labeling is compliant, and pharmacovigilance systems are in place. Regulatory professionals must
stay up to date with evolving legislation and guidance documents, as non-compliance can result in
delayed product approvals, fines, or even market bans.

The scope of regulatory affairs is not limited to product approval. It extends to lifecycle
management, including post-marketing surveillance, renewals, and variations. Companies often rely on
regulatory intelligence to anticipate changes in global legislation and proactively adjust their
strategies. As global markets expand, pharmaceutical companies increasingly need to harmonize their
regulatory strategies across jurisdictions while addressing country-specific requirements. This need
gives rise to regulatory harmonization initiatives like ICH (International Council for
Harmonisation) and WHO’s collaborative registration procedures.

Ultimately, regulatory affairs ensure that patients have timely access to safe and effective
medications. It helps companies navigate a highly regulated environment, reduce compliance risks,
and bring innovations to market faster. As the regulatory landscape becomes more complex with the
advent of gene therapy, biosimilars, and personalized medicine, the demand for skilled regulatory
professionals continues to rise. For these reasons, pharma regulatory affairs are not just a support

quality and packaging. We manufacture several sensitive products like Cardio-vascular, Diabetic

# Adventure awaits - before they go, consider cholera protection

## Why VAXCHORA?¹

### Indication and usage

VAXCHORA is a vaccine indicated for active immunization against disease caused by Vibrio cholerae
serogroup O1 in persons 2 through 64 years of age traveling to cholera-affected areas.

**Limitations of Use:** The effectiveness of VAXCHORA has not been established in persons living in
cholera-affected areas. The effectiveness of VAXCHORA has not been established in persons who have
pre-existing immunity due to previous exposure to V. cholerae or receipt of a cholera vaccine.
VAXCHORA has not been shown to protect against disease caused by V. cholerae serogroup O139 or other
non-O1 serogroups.

**The Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) recommends VAXCHORA for people 2 through
64 years of age who are traveling to an area with active cholera transmission.^{2*}**

To read the full recommendation and see the most recent updates, visit the CDC website.

[Read CDC Recommendation Here][14]

*The CDC considers cholera transmission to be active in a country when any of the following criteria
are met:
* • WHO reports a cholera outbreak (e.g., annual reports, outbreak bulletins, disease outbreak news)
  • A country reports more than 100 suspected cholera cases in the previous 12 months as documented
  by reliable, publicly available sources such as WHO or the Ministries of Health
  • CDC experts have reviewed available information and have determined that cholera is likely
  present even if not officially reported

CDC, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; WHO, World Health Organization.

randomized according to a 1:1 ratio to receive 1 dose of VAXCHORA or placebo. The co-primary
objectives were to demonstrate the efficacy of a single dose of VAXCHORA in the prevention of
moderate to severe diarrhea following challenge at 10 days and 3 months post-vaccination.^{1,3,a,b}

Pre-specified criteria for success were that the lower bound of the two-sided 95% confidence
interval for vaccine efficacy must be ≥30% in both the 10 Day and 3 Month challenge groups.¹

# From Within

Background & Rationale

## A Critical Gap in Southern Africa's Animal Health System

Zambia's animal production sector — spanning smallholder and commercial poultry and livestock — is a
critical engine of food security, rural income, and national economic growth. Yet recurrent disease
outbreaks continue to erode productivity and sustain deep dependence on imported veterinary
vaccines.

Imported vaccines are frequently ill-matched to locally circulating strains and are constrained by
fragile cold-chain infrastructure, severely limiting their effectiveness in rural and pastoral
settings where disease pressure is highest.

This initiative proposes the establishment of a **thermostable animal vaccine R&D and manufacturing
facility** in Zambia — structured through a public-private partnership model under a hybrid
university-based incubation and joint-venture governance framework, with the Industrial Development
Corporation (IDC) of Zambia as primary institutional anchor.

Local manufacturing will reduce import dependence, improve vaccine effectiveness under field
conditions, create high-quality scientific employment, and position Zambia as a regional vaccine
supply hub across Southern Africa. The project aligns with Zambia's national industrialization goals
and strengthens global One Health, biosecurity, and pandemic prevention frameworks.

Strategic Impact Areas

## Four Pillars of Transformational Impact

One Health infrastructure that creates economic value, protects livelihoods, and builds lasting
regional capacity.

01

### Food Security

Protecting poultry and livestock from devastating disease outbreaks that erode smallholder
livelihoods and commercial operations across Zambia.

02

### Economic Growth

Skilled scientific employment and import substitution across the vaccine value chain, retaining
economic value within Zambia's borders.

03

### Pandemic Prevention

Strengthening One Health biosecurity at the animal–human interface, reducing spillover risk and
aligning with global health security frameworks.

##### The land of the legendary African walking safari, Victoria Falls, the wild Zambezi River,
##### abundant wildlife and untamed wilderness – all in one friendly country.
##### 
##### Blessed with awe-inspiring natural wonders, a plethora of wildlife, huge bodies of water and
##### vast open spaces, Zambia offers unforgettable holidays exploring the real Africa.
##### 
##### Acknowledged as one of the safest countries in the world to visit, Zambia’s welcoming people
##### live in peace and harmony.
##### 
##### And here, in the warm heart of Africa, you will find some of the finest safari experiences on
##### the planet, including face-to-face encounters with nature at its most untrammelled.
##### Spectacular waterways provide adrenaline thrills or a leisurely playground for all ages. The

#####

##### 
##### Acknowledged as one of the safest countries in the world to visit, Zambia’s welcoming people
##### live in peace and harmony.
##### 
##### And here, in the warm heart of Africa, you will find some of the finest safari experiences on
##### the planet, including face-to-face encounters with nature at its most untrammelled.

##### birdlife is among the most diverse in the world.
##### 
##### Seventeen magnificent waterfalls, in addition to the spectacular Victoria Falls, provide avid
##### adventurers with unique experiences and a taste of village life. Spectacular daily sunsets are
##### almost guaranteed in this slice of paradise.
